name: WaterSewerDrainage_WFL1
title: Water Sewer and Drainage Contact Areas
description:
Overview

This hosted feature service provides contact and service-area information for Broward County utility providers. It brings together three polygon layers representing the areas served by drainage districts, water providers, and sewer service providers, with each layer including associated contact details and website information.

Feature Layers
  • Drainage District: Polygon features for drainage district service areas with district name, contact person, phone number, email, and website information.
  • Water Provider: Polygon features for water service areas with provider name, phone number, email, and website information.
  • Sewer Service Provider: Polygon features for sewer service areas with provider name, phone number, email, and website information.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers Broward County, Florida, and supports local utility reference and service-area lookup across the county.

Use Cases
  • Finding the responsible utility or drainage contact for a location
  • Supporting customer service and public information workflows
  • Displaying local service boundaries in web maps and GIS applications
  • Assisting planning, coordination, and property-related inquiries
snippet: Polygon service areas and contact information for drainage districts, water providers, and sewer service providers in Broward County, Florida.
